description: Flat root inventory (hosts.ini, group_vars/, host_vars/ at the root) with playbooks in playbooks/ that have their own group_vars/. The root group_vars are inventory-adjacent (L4/L6) for every playbook; playbooks/group_vars are playbook-level (L5/L7) only for playbooks in playbooks/.
notes: ansible-playbook playbooks/site.yml gives host-pbdir-playbooks (research probe 07, layout A).
